'''January 2001 Meriden tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at DJs Comics, Meriden, CT on 13 January 2001. [[Andy Klema]] won it. It is known from Keith Henderson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1636">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-17-meriden-ct-01-13-01d1636/ meriden-ct-01-13-01], DeckTech (Keith "Tessek-CPA" Henderson, 17 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-17-meriden-ct-01-13-01d1636/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 January 2001
* '''Site:''' DJs Comics, Meriden, CT
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 24
* '''Winner:''' [[Andy Klema]]
